name: M&T Bank Corporation
moat_justification: Moderate regional-bank moat: a sticky low-cost core deposit franchise in the Northeast/Mid-Atlantic, disciplined conservative underwriting (nonaccruals 0.84% of loans at Q2 2026, falling charge-offs), and through-cycle returns (FY2025 ROA 1.35%, common ROE 10.27%) — against a commodity banking product with no structural pricing power, full exposure to the credit and rate cycle (CRE book in deliberate runoff), regulatory capital limits on capital return (CET1 down to 10.19% at Q2 2026 from 10.99% a year earlier as buybacks and loan growth consume capital), and national-scale competitors.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Capital expenditures, net': $143M for FY2025, with $216M for FY2024 in the same statement (corroborated by the filer's 10-Q cash-flow statements: $87M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2025 and $131M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2024, with Q4 adding the remainder in each year)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.4x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Disciplined regional bank, moat 5/10 — normalized OE $20.03/sh is a 9.3% yield at $215.43, but weighted IRR is only 11.85% (IV@15% $161.09), so it clears 15% only below ~$161; bank-model mismatch, confidence low.
moat_for: Sticky low-cost core deposit base — $163.5B deposits funding a Northeast/Mid-Atlantic relationship franchise
Disciplined underwriting culture — nonaccruals 0.84% of loans and net charge-offs 0.23% annualized at Q2 2026, improving
Through-cycle profitability — OE positive 5 of last 5 FY, FY2025 net income $2,851M, ROA 1.35%
Scale in its footprint — ~$216B assets, largest regional headquartered in Buffalo; Wilmington Trust wealth arm adds fee income
Consistent capital return — diluted shares down from 167.3M (FY2024) to 158.8M (FY2025), buybacks continuing in 2026
moat_against: Commodity product — deposits and loans are fungible; no network effect or structural pricing power (NIM 3.70% is earned, not owned)
Credit-cycle exposure — commercial real estate book in deliberate runoff ($24.0B at Sep 2025 vs $28.7B a year earlier); a recession hits provisions first
Capital-constrained growth — CET1 fell to 10.19% at Q2 2026 from 10.99% a year earlier; buybacks compete with loan growth for capital
Rate sensitivity — earnings ride NIM and the yield curve; deposit repricing pressure is outside management control
Scale disadvantage vs national banks' technology and compliance budgets

overrides.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Capital expenditures, net': $143M for FY2025, with $216M for FY2024 in the same statement (corroborated by the filer's 10-Q cash-flow statements: $87M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2025 and $131M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2024, with Q4 adding the remainder in each year)
